question: In December 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi condoled the passing of Shri Swaraj Kaushal ji. He served as the Governor of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief on the passing of Shri Swaraj Kaushal ji, who served as the youngest Governor of Mizoram.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Swaraj Kaushal served as the Governor of Mizoram from 1990 to 1993.**
 
• **He became India’s youngest Governor at age 37.**
 
• Remembered for his impactful tenure and contribution to the people of Mizoram.
 
• Also served as a senior advocate and parliamentarian known for legal expertise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Swaraj Kaushal**__

 __
 
• Indian criminal lawyer & senior advocate at age 34.
 
• Youngest Governor of India during his appointment.
 
• Served as Governor of Mizoram (1990–1993).
 
 
 
• **Role as Governor**__
 __
 
• Known for outreach and public engagement with Mizoram citizens.
 
• Praised for administrative insight and peace-building efforts.
 
 
 
• **Legacy**__
 __
 
• Remembered as a jurist dedicated to uplifting underprivileged communities.
 
• PM acknowledged his contribution to Parliament and public service.
 
 
 
• **Condolence by PM Modi**__
 
 
• Message posted on X expressing sorrow.
 
• Extended condolences to his daughter Bansuri and family.
